name: keep-notes-mern
description: A collaborative Google Keep-style notes app on the MERN stack — real-time sync, sharing, version history, reminders, two-factor auth and markdown notes

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
